family.description: This entry represents sporulation protein SpoIIT and related proteins. TATA-box_bdg is a family of bacterial proteins.SpoIIT from Bacillus subtilis contains a circularly permuted TATA-box binding protein-like fold. It participates in cell-cell signalling pathways during sporulation. It functions in the SpoIIGA-dependent proteolytic activation of sigma E in the mother cell [[cite:PUB00162567]].
family.name: Sporulation protein SpoIIT
